| description = Mammoth walks from 756,-2522 to -328, -2342. (Spawn appears to be random mammoth/calf PH's so he could path anywhere his PH does)<br>
(At least one place holder spawns at 837, -2537 on a 6:00 minute timer (where the zone is listed as 6:40) 3/2/21)

Tainted has also been spotted pathing on the ice river near the fork.

Be aware - if [[Tundra Jack]] stumbles in to your fight, he will kill-steal. This is a double edged sword, because Tundra Jack will also help you kill PH's as he paths back and forth. You can either pull the mammoth out of the way towards a zone wall, or Harmony Tundra Jack if you are able to see him coming from a  distance.

Spawns [[corrupted wooly mammoth]] when killed. A giant aggressive mammoth. Have fun!
